assessment.rootCause: The observed profile image omitted the Cordis overlays from their canonical package targets. Cordis accesses those targets through apps/cli/node_modules/@deepseek-ai directory symlinks, so the profile image must retain both target files and the package-directory alias links.
assessment.fixImplemented: The profile image builder now includes the two source overlays at packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml and packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml, preserves the CLI alias-directory symlinks to those package directories, and binds/validates the runtime alias mapping and exact overlay digests in the image manifest. It does not create regular files beneath alias directories that must be recreated as symlinks.
